name: WebWalkerQA
description: WebWalkerQA is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to perform web traversal by systematically navigating subpages to extract high-quality information. It tests complex, multi-layered information retrieval capabilities beyond traditional search engines.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for web traversal and multi-hop information extraction, with limited adoption compared with mainstream web QA datasets.
notes: Includes a multi-agent framework (WebWalker) to mimic human-like web navigation.
